desc.en: It is narrated from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a) that when the Holy Prophet (s) passed away and Abu Bakr occupied his position, he sent his representative to the caretaker of Lady Fatima (s) and expelled him from Fadak, after which, in order to prove her right, she presented His Eminence, Ali and Umme Aiman as her witnesses and Umar said: Umme Aiman is a female and we don’t accept the testimony of a female, and Ali is testifying for his vested interest, so it is of no use. This infuriated Lady Fatima (s) and she said…
desc.rurdu: Imam Jafar Sadiq (a) se riwaayat hai keh jab Rasool-e-Khuda (s) is duniya se chal-basey to Abu Bakr unki jagah par baiyth gaya, us ne apne faujiyo’n ko bhej kar Bibi Fatema (s) ke Fadak mein kaam karne waalo’n ko wahan se nikaal bahaar kiya aur us baug par kabza kar liya, chunaan-che apne haq ko talab karte huwe Bibi Fatema (s) ne gawahi ke taur par Imam Ali (a) aur Umme Aiman ko pesh kiya to us waqt Umar ne un dono gawaho’n ko radd kiya, yeh kehte huwe keh Umme Aiman aurat hai aur ham aurat ki gawahi qabool nahi karte, Ali apne zaati mafaad (faiyde) ke liye gawahi de rahe hai to aisi gawahi hamein manzoor nahi hai. Is baat ne Bibi Fatema (s) ko gazab-naak kiya aur unho ne is tarah se kaha…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّهُمَا ظَلَمَا اِبْنَۃَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِیِّكَ حَقَّهَا، فَاشْدُدْ وَطْاَتَكَ عَلَیْهِمَا۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNAHOMAA ZALAMAA IBNATA MOHAMMADIN NABIYYEKA HAQQAHAA, FASH-DUD WAT-A-TAKA A’LAYHEMAA.

trans.en: O Allah, they have oppressed the right of the daughter of Your Prophet so increase your anger on them.
trans.rurdu: Ay Allah! In logo’n ne Tere Rasool (s) ki beti ka haq ghazb kiya hai, lehaaza Tu apne gazab ko in par badha de.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
